news_2026-11-12T20-43-24_panama-canal-dr.caption:
When the Panama Canal dries up, freight trains become the new ocean lanes—and your online cart pays the price. 🚚⚓

Here is how a drought in Central America rewires the global economy:
• Rain levels drop in Panama's fresh-water locks.
• Cargo ships queue for weeks or pay $4M to skip the line.
• Freight shifts to 'dry canals' (trains crossing from ocean to ocean).
• Extra crane lifts & rail fees add hundreds to container costs.
• Consumers see higher prices and delivery delays at store checkouts.

Will land-based rail corridors ever fully replace historic ocean canals?
